<script>
const state = {
  targetTemp: 37.7,
  humidity: 58,
  espTemp: 65,
  tray1Day: 10,
  tray2Day: 4
};
function updateClock() {
  const now = new Date();
  const h = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,'0');
  const m = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
  const s = String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('topClock').textContent = `${h}:${m}:${s}`;
}
function refreshStatus() {
  document.getElementById('statusApi').textContent = 'OK';
  document.getElementById('statusEsp').textContent = state.espTemp;
  document.getElementById('statusHum').textContent = state.humidity;
  document.getElementById('chamberTemp').textContent = state.targetTemp.toFixed(1);
  document.getElementById('humidTarget').textContent = state.humidity + '%';
  document.getElementById('ds1').textContent = '37.6°C';
  document.getElementById('ds2').textContent = '37.9°C';
  document.getElementById('tray1Status').textContent = `Dzień ${state.tray1Day}`;
  document.getElementById('tray2Status').textContent = `Dzień ${state.tray2Day}`;
}
function switchTab(event, tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.tab === tab));
  document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(view => {
    view.style.display = view.id === 'view-' + tab ? 'block' : 'none';
  });
}
function openIndex() {
  window.location.href = 'index.html';
}
function openDocs() {
  window.location.href = '/docs-v1-1';
}
function applyPreset() {
  const day = Number(document.getElementById('dayInput').value) || 1;
  state.tray1Day = day;
  state.tray2Day = Math.max(1, day - 6);
  refreshStatus();
}
function resetPreset() {
  document.getElementById('speciesSelect').value = 'CHICKEN';
  document.getElementById('dayInput').value = 1;
  document.getElementById('traySelect').value = '1';
  state.tray1Day = 1;
  state.tray2Day = 1;
  refreshStatus();
}
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  updateClock();
  refreshStatus();
  setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
});
</script>

            async function fetchJsonWithTimeout(url, options={}, timeoutMs=API_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS) {
                const controller = new AbortController();
                const signal = controller.signal;
                const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
                try {
                    const resp = await fetch(url, { ...options, signal });
                    clearTimeout(timer);
                    return resp;
                } catch (e) {
                    clearTimeout(timer);
                    throw e;
                }
            }

            async function fetchJson(url, options={}, timeoutMs=API_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS) {
                const response = await fetchJsonWithTimeout(url, options, timeoutMs);
                return response.json();
            }

            async function fetchData() {
                try {
                    const [statusResp, trayResp] = await Promise.all([
                        fetchJson('/api/status', {}, API_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS),
                        fetchJson('/api/trays', {}, API_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS)
                    ]);
                    statusData = statusResp;
                    trayData = trayResp;
                    apiOnline = true;
                    apiRetries = 0;
                } catch (e) {
                    apiRetries++;
                    if (apiRetries >= 3) apiOnline = false;
                    console.warn('Błąd pobierania danych, używam symulacji:', e.message);
                    statusData = {
                        temp_chamber: 37.65 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2,
                        temp_aquarium: 37.55 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2,
                        humidity: 60.2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
                        target_temp: 37.7,
                        target_humidity: 60.0,
                        humidity_target_min: 55,
                        humidity_target_max: 65,
                        heater_pwm_ch0: 1500 + Math.random() * 1000,
                        heater_pwm_ch1: 800 + Math.random() * 800,
                        diffuser_0_on: Math.random() > 0.5,
                        esp_internal_temp: 42 + Math.random() * 6
                    };
                    trayData = { trays: [{ species_id: 'CHICKEN', current_day: 12, total_days: 21 }, { species_id: 'DUCK', current_day: 8, total_days: 28 }] };
                }

                if (statusData) {
                    const avgTemp = statusData.temp_chamber ?? 0;
                    const rh = statusData.humidity ?? 0;
                    history.push({ temp: avgTemp, wilg: rh, timestamp: Date.now() });
                    if (history.length > HISTORY_LEN) history.shift();
                    trendHistory.push({ temp: avgTemp, rh: rh, timestamp: Date.now() });
                    if (trendHistory.length > TREND_LEN * 2) trendHistory.shift();
                    updateHUD();
                    updateToolbar();
                    draw();
                    drawTrend();
                    updateAlerts();
                    renderCharts();
                }
                if (trayData) {
                    updateTrays();
                    renderScheduleTables();
                }
            }
